newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel blocked on upside by 130.40 cap.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel blocked on upside by 130.40 cap.

text.p: The September notionnel will find it hard to make significant progress on the upside on Wednesday, with a strong obstacle at 130.40 and interim resistance ahead of that, technical analysts said.
Anil Patel, technical analyst at Nomura International in London, said 130.40 was where a previous uptrend line came in.
"If you make a trendline from 126.40 (a June 2 low) to 129.02 on July 1, it continues up to 130.40 today," he said.
The market broke below that line earlier this week and it was now acting as resistance. The September notionnel on the MATIF was at 130.06, up 0.08 at 0851 GMT.
Patel said he saw the market going lower. He noted a key level was the low on Tuesday at 129.80, which he said was also a 50 percent retracement level.
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, was also bearish.
He said he expected a pullback on the September contract, with strong resistance at 130.38 to thwart any rallies.
Adcock said that after the recent uptrend break, the market would head for 129.18.
September Pibor was steady in early trade, at 96.50, up 0.01 from the prior close.
